source: curated root-cause taxonomy (frozen with this plugin release)

rootCauses.description: An approved requirement was not decomposed, implemented, or verified.
Work advanced without the evidence required by a milestone gate.
Current implementation behavior conflicts with an atomic Ground Truth assertion.
An applicable test exists but has no current execution result.
Evidence is stale or cannot be bound to the current source or deliverable.
A reported conclusion contradicts its cited primary evidence.
The checker failed or could not reliably classify an object.
An external environment prevented required verification.
A mandatory Skill step or prerequisite was omitted.
Skill steps were executed in a prohibited order.
A conditional Skill constraint was violated after its condition became active.
A Skill used invalid inputs or did not produce a required output.
The Skill execution performed an explicitly prohibited action.
The output added behavior without an authoritative basis.
A required workflow step, edge, or traceability relation is incomplete.
The deviation does not yet map to a more specific frozen cause.
